units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|As you explore the spaceport of <origin>, you come across a small grassy park, the greenspace a welcome contrast to the otherwise mechanical facilities. As the centerpiece of the park, where you'd expect a fountain or a statue in a human park, is a curious hanging windchime, made of pieces of colorful glass and various metals. It's more than a little mesmerizing, and you stop to listen as it rustles in the gentle circulation of the station's air.|26|0
units.english: As you explore the spaceport of <origin>, you come across a small grassy park, the greenspace a welcome contrast to the otherwise mechanical facilities. As the centerpiece of the park, where you'd expect a fountain or a statue in a human park, is a curious hanging windchime, made of pieces of colorful glass and various metals. It's more than a little mesmerizing, and you stop to listen as it rustles in the gentle circulation of the station's air.
units.italian: Mentre esplori lo spazioporto di <origin>, ti imbatti in un piccolo parco erboso, il verde come gradito contrasto con gli impianti per il resto meccanici. Al centro del parco, dove in un parco umano ti aspetteresti una fontana o una statua, c'è uno strano carillon a vento sospeso, fatto di pezzi di vetro colorato e di vari metalli. È più che un po' ipnotico, e ti fermi ad ascoltare mentre stormisce nella circolazione gentile dell'aria della stazione.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Is this one of the humans I have heard so much about, question?" The translator tucked behind your ear suddenly speaks, responding to an Avgi voice. You turn and see an Avgi perched on a park bench behind you, his purple coloring faded with age. A board of colorful stones sits on the table in front of him, a game of some kind. He gives you an odd sort of salute with a forelimb, probably an Avgi greeting of some kind.|27|0
units.english: "Is this one of the humans I have heard so much about, question?" The translator tucked behind your ear suddenly speaks, responding to an Avgi voice. You turn and see an Avgi perched on a park bench behind you, his purple coloring faded with age. A board of colorful stones sits on the table in front of him, a game of some kind. He gives you an odd sort of salute with a forelimb, probably an Avgi greeting of some kind.
units.italian: "È questo uno degli umani di cui ho tanto sentito parlare, domanda?" Il traduttore infilato dietro il tuo orecchio parla all'improvviso, rispondendo a una voce Avgi. Ti volti e vedi un Avgi appollaiato su una panchina del parco dietro di te, la colorazione violacea sbiadita dall'età. Davanti a lui, su un tavolo, c'è una tavola di pietre colorate: una sorta di gioco. Ti fa un saluto strano con un arto anteriore, probabilmente un qualche saluto Avgi.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Hello there."|29|0
units.english: "Hello there."
units.italian: "Salve."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Hi, I'm Captain <first> <last>."|30|0
units.english: "Hi, I'm Captain <first> <last>."
units.italian: "Ciao, sono il capitano <first> <last>."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Courteous introduction. I am called Wisteria. Would you grace me with your own name?"|32|0
units.english: "Courteous introduction. I am called Wisteria. Would you grace me with your own name?"
units.italian: "Presentazione cortese. Mi chiamo Wisteria. Mi onoreresti del tuo nome?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"I'm Captain <first> <last>," you say.|33|0
units.english: "I'm Captain <first> <last>," you say.
units.italian: "Sono il capitano <first> <last>," dici.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Appreciated meeting. A pleasure to meet you, Captain <last>. Would you like to join old Wisteria at a game of Trefoil, question? I would be happy to teach you how to play, of course."|35|0
units.english: "Appreciated meeting. A pleasure to meet you, Captain <last>. Would you like to join old Wisteria at a game of Trefoil, question? I would be happy to teach you how to play, of course."
units.italian: "Incontro gradito. Piacere di conoscerti, capitano <last>. Ti andrebbe di unirti al vecchio Wisteria per una partita a Trefoil, domanda? Sarò felice di insegnarti a giocare, naturalmente."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Sure."|37|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"No thank you."|38|0
units.english: "No thank you."
units.italian: "No, grazie."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Delight. The youth these days have little appreciation for the art of Trefoil, you know." He taps one eye knowingly, an odd gesture. "Or at least my mother would say. That was sixty years ago, hmm. Please, sit, sit!" He points to the other side of his bench, with nothing more than a horizontal rail for a seat.|40|0
units.english: "Delight. The youth these days have little appreciation for the art of Trefoil, you know." He taps one eye knowingly, an odd gesture. "Or at least my mother would say. That was sixty years ago, hmm. Please, sit, sit!" He points to the other side of his bench, with nothing more than a horizontal rail for a seat.
units.italian: "Gioia. I giovani di oggi apprezzano poco l'arte del Trefoil, sai." Si tocca un occhio con aria saputa, un gesto strano. "O almeno così direbbe mia madre. Erano sessant'anni fa, hmm. Prego, siediti, siediti!" Indica l'altro lato della panchina, che come sedile ha solo una sbarra orizzontale.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"That sure looks comfortable."|42|0
units.english: "That sure looks comfortable."
units.italian: "Sembra proprio comodo."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"I'll stand, I think."|43|0
units.english: "I'll stand, I think."
units.italian: "Penso che resterò in piedi."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Amusement. The other humans had chairs made to suit your forms, they did. Folded them up and carried them everywhere."|44|0
units.english: "Amusement. The other humans had chairs made to suit your forms, they did. Folded them up and carried them everywhere."
units.italian: "Divertimento. Gli altri umani avevano sedie fatte su misura per le vostre forme, sai. Le piegavano e se le portavano ovunque."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Did you meet them?" you ask.|45|0
units.english: "Did you meet them?" you ask.
units.italian: "Li hai incontrati?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Yes, yes. Several times. Only the angry one was any good at Trefoil, sadly. Speaking of which-" He deftly rearranges the colored stones, arranging them into a neat pattern: three triangles, one of each color, angled with their topmost points touching at the center of a six-sided board.|46|0
units.english: "Yes, yes. Several times. Only the angry one was any good at Trefoil, sadly. Speaking of which-" He deftly rearranges the colored stones, arranging them into a neat pattern: three triangles, one of each color, angled with their topmost points touching at the center of a six-sided board.
units.italian: "Sì, sì. Diverse volte. Solo quello arrabbiato era bravo al Trefoil, purtroppo. A proposito..." Riordina abilmente le pietre colorate, disponendole in uno schema ordinato: tre triangoli, uno per colore, inclinati con le punte che si toccano al centro di una tavola esagonale.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Respectful deference. Which color would you like to play as, question? There is no real difference between them, as far as the game plays."|50|0
units.english: "Respectful deference. Which color would you like to play as, question? There is no real difference between them, as far as the game plays."
units.italian: "Deferenza rispettosa. Con quale colore vuoi giocare, domanda? Non c'è differenza reale tra loro, per come si gioca."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Red."|52|0
units.english: "Red."
units.italian: "Rosso."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Green."|53|0
units.english: "Green."
units.italian: "Verde."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Blue."|54|0
units.english: "Blue."
units.italian: "Blu."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Acknowledgment. Excellent. Explanation. The objective is to remove all of your pieces from the board by moving them to the opposite edge to your own triangle." Demonstrating with a stone, he shows you how to skip it over connected chains of other pieces, moving to their endpoint. "You must balance your moves between freeing your own pieces and blocking the other colors from their own escape."|55|0
units.english: "Acknowledgment. Excellent. Explanation. The objective is to remove all of your pieces from the board by moving them to the opposite edge to your own triangle." Demonstrating with a stone, he shows you how to skip it over connected chains of other pieces, moving to their endpoint. "You must balance your moves between freeing your own pieces and blocking the other colors from their own escape."
units.italian: "Preso atto. Eccellente. Spiegazione. L'obiettivo è togliere dalla tavola tutti i tuoi pezzi, spostandoli sul bordo opposto al tuo triangolo." Dimostrando con una pietra, ti mostra come farla saltare sopra catene collegate di altri pezzi, fino al loro punto terminale. "Devi bilanciare le mosse tra liberare i tuoi pezzi e bloccare gli altri colori nella loro fuga."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	You delicately take a seat on the rail. It's at least only a little worse than a park bench, and you're thankful for the lower gravity on Peripheria.|56|0
units.english: You delicately take a seat on the rail. It's at least only a little worse than a park bench, and you're thankful for the lower gravity on Peripheria.
units.italian: Ti siedi con delicatezza sulla sbarra. È solo un po' peggio di una panchina, e sei grato per la gravità più bassa di Peripheria.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"But there's three sides and only two of us."|58|0
units.english: "But there's three sides and only two of us."
units.italian: "Ma ci sono tre lati e solo due di noi."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. An astute observation. The third color can be played by a third person, in some variations, but in our case we take turns moving for it. It - the Foil - is an external actor, under our influence yet outside our absolute control, often used as a pawn to block the other player's moves when opportune. Now, would you like to make the first move, question? Players generally either focus on either evacuating their own pieces or moving to block their opponent's path to escape."|59|0
units.english: "Approving. An astute observation. The third color can be played by a third person, in some variations, but in our case we take turns moving for it. It - the Foil - is an external actor, under our influence yet outside our absolute control, often used as a pawn to block the other player's moves when opportune. Now, would you like to make the first move, question? Players generally either focus on either evacuating their own pieces or moving to block their opponent's path to escape."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Un'osservazione acuta. Il terzo colore può essere giocato da una terza persona, in alcune varianti, ma nel nostro caso muoviamo a turno per lui. Esso, il Foil, è un attore esterno, sotto la nostra influenza ma fuori dal nostro controllo assoluto, spesso usato come pedina per bloccare le mosse dell'altro giocatore quando è opportuno. Ora, vuoi fare la prima mossa, domanda? I giocatori in genere si concentrano o sull'evacuare i propri pezzi o sul bloccare la via di fuga dell'avversario."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Focus on getting my stones out. Move a stone towards my color's escape.)|62|0
units.english: (Focus on getting my stones out. Move a stone towards my color's escape.)
units.italian: (Concentrati sul far uscire le mie pietre. Muovi una pietra verso la fuga del mio colore.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Focus on blocking Wisteria. Move a stone towards his triangle.)|64|0
units.english: (Focus on blocking Wisteria. Move a stone towards his triangle.)
units.italian: (Concentrati sul bloccare Wisteria. Muovi una pietra verso il suo triangolo.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Focus on blocking the Foil. Move a stone towards its triangle.)|66|0
units.english: (Focus on blocking the Foil. Move a stone towards its triangle.)
units.italian: (Concentrati sul bloccare il Foil. Muovi una pietra verso il suo triangolo.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. A good approach. That is the classical move to make at the start of the game, especially for a beginner."|72|0
units.english: "Approving. A good approach. That is the classical move to make at the start of the game, especially for a beginner."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Un buon approccio. È la mossa classica da fare all'inizio della partita, soprattutto per un principiante."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|label|75|0
units.english: block wisteria 1
units.italian: block wisteria 1

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Amusement. Ah, already moving to block me, I see. That is often an approach taken by more advanced players, but I must warn you, executing it successfully is difficult."|78|0
units.english: "Amusement. Ah, already moving to block me, I see. That is often an approach taken by more advanced players, but I must warn you, executing it successfully is difficult."
units.italian: "Divertimento. Ah, già ti muovi per bloccarmi, vedo. È spesso un approccio dei giocatori più esperti, ma devo avvertirti: eseguirlo con successo è difficile."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|label|81|0
units.english: block foil 1
units.italian: block foil 1

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Interest. I do not often see players prioritize blocking the Foil, especially as their first move. But perhaps you will surprise me."|84|0
units.english: "Interest. I do not often see players prioritize blocking the Foil, especially as their first move. But perhaps you will surprise me."
units.italian: "Interesse. Non vedo spesso giocatori dare priorità al bloccare il Foil, soprattutto come prima mossa. Ma forse mi sorprenderai."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	Slightly adjusting his position on the bench, the Avgi continues. "Now, after each of our turns, we shall move one of the Foil's pieces. You should focus on moving them to your advantage, whether that be by blocking my pieces or keeping them out of the way of your own."|88|0
units.english: Slightly adjusting his position on the bench, the Avgi continues. "Now, after each of our turns, we shall move one of the Foil's pieces. You should focus on moving them to your advantage, whether that be by blocking my pieces or keeping them out of the way of your own."
units.italian: Sistemando leggermente la propria posizione sulla panchina, l'Avgi continua. "Ora, dopo ciascuno dei nostri turni, muoveremo un pezzo del Foil. Dovresti concentrarti sul muoverli a tuo vantaggio, sia bloccando i miei pezzi sia tenendoli fuori dalla strada dei tuoi."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Move one of the Foil's stones towards my own side, to start building a link.)|90|0
units.english: (Move one of the Foil's stones towards my own side, to start building a link.)
units.italian: (Muovi una pietra del Foil verso il mio lato, per cominciare a costruire un collegamento.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Move one of the Foil's stones towards Wisteria's side, to block him in the future.)|92|0
units.english: (Move one of the Foil's stones towards Wisteria's side, to block him in the future.)
units.italian: (Muovi una pietra del Foil verso il lato di Wisteria, per bloccarlo in futuro.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Move one of the Foil's stones towards its own exit. Why not?)|94|0
units.english: (Move one of the Foil's stones towards its own exit. Why not?)
units.italian: (Muovi una pietra del Foil verso la sua uscita. Perché no?)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. A wise approach, to prepare to build bridges in the future. It is more complex, and can be difficult, but is often well-rewarded in the end. Of course, you must take care not to accidentally box yourself in, and create a chain that lacks endpoints closer to your exit."|100|0
units.english: "Approving. A wise approach, to prepare to build bridges in the future. It is more complex, and can be difficult, but is often well-rewarded in the end. Of course, you must take care not to accidentally box yourself in, and create a chain that lacks endpoints closer to your exit."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Un approccio saggio, prepararsi a costruire ponti in futuro. È più complesso e può essere difficile, ma spesso ben ripagato alla fine. Naturalmente devi fare attenzione a non rinchiuderti per errore, creando una catena priva di estremità vicine alla tua uscita."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|label|103|0
units.english: block wisteria 2
units.italian: block wisteria 2

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Interest. It is a good move, to try and build a wall I cannot jump over, but you must take care not to accidentally create a chain with an endpoint placed to my advantage."|106|0
units.english: "Interest. It is a good move, to try and build a wall I cannot jump over, but you must take care not to accidentally create a chain with an endpoint placed to my advantage."
units.italian: "Interesse. È una buona mossa, cercare di costruire un muro che non posso superare, ma devi fare attenzione a non creare per errore una catena con un'estremità a mio vantaggio."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|label|109|0
units.english: escape foil 2
units.italian: escape foil 2

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Surprise. I have not seen that done before. The Foil cannot win, of course, so you have nothing to gain by removing its pieces from the board aside from denying them to the opposing player."|112|0
units.english: "Surprise. I have not seen that done before. The Foil cannot win, of course, so you have nothing to gain by removing its pieces from the board aside from denying them to the opposing player."
units.italian: "Sorpresa. Non ho mai visto farlo. Il Foil non può vincere, naturalmente, quindi non hai nulla da guadagnare togliendo i suoi pezzi dalla tavola, se non negarli all'altro giocatore."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	Wisteria studies the board for a brief moment before moving one of his pieces towards his exit, then quickly moving a Foil piece towards his triangle. "Curiosity. I must confess, I wonder what our civilization looks like to an outsider, in the state it is in."|116|0
units.english: Wisteria studies the board for a brief moment before moving one of his pieces towards his exit, then quickly moving a Foil piece towards his triangle. "Curiosity. I must confess, I wonder what our civilization looks like to an outsider, in the state it is in."
units.italian: Wisteria studia la tavola per un breve momento, poi muove uno dei suoi pezzi verso la propria uscita e subito dopo un pezzo del Foil verso il suo triangolo. "Curiosità. Devo confessare che mi chiedo come appaia la nostra civiltà a un estraneo, nello stato in cui si trova."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"It's impressive that you've been able to keep on fighting, even out here."|118|0
units.english: "It's impressive that you've been able to keep on fighting, even out here."
units.italian: "È impressionante che siate riusciti a continuare a combattere, perfino quaggiù."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"It seems like everyone lives a hard life out here."|120|0
units.english: "It seems like everyone lives a hard life out here."
units.italian: "Sembra che quaggiù tutti vivano una vita dura."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"I don't think I've seen enough of it to say anything, to be honest."|122|0
units.english: "I don't think I've seen enough of it to say anything, to be honest."
units.italian: "Non credo di averne visto abbastanza per dire qualcosa, a essere onesto."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Contemplation. Yes. Fighting. A vice we have never quite been able to escape, and yet some would say we should be grateful for that now. For without the long millennia to sharpen the spear of war, how much worse would we have fared against the Aberrant, question? And yet my old bones grow weary with every failed expedition to reclaim Aviskir, and I hear the voices crying out that enough is enough, and to give up on our old worlds and build a new life out here."|126|0
units.english: "Contemplation. Yes. Fighting. A vice we have never quite been able to escape, and yet some would say we should be grateful for that now. For without the long millennia to sharpen the spear of war, how much worse would we have fared against the Aberrant, question? And yet my old bones grow weary with every failed expedition to reclaim Aviskir, and I hear the voices crying out that enough is enough, and to give up on our old worlds and build a new life out here."
units.italian: "Contemplazione. Sì. Combattere. Un vizio da cui non siamo mai riusciti davvero a fuggire, eppure qualcuno direbbe che ora dovremmo esserne grati. Perché senza i lunghi millenni che hanno affilato la lancia della guerra, come ci saremmo comportati contro l'Aberrante, domanda? E tuttavia le mie vecchie ossa si stancano a ogni spedizione fallita per riconquistare Aviskir, e sento voci che gridano che basta, che è ora di rinunciare ai nostri vecchi mondi e costruire quaggiù una vita nuova."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|label|129|0
units.english: hard life
units.italian: hard life

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Agreement. Yes, we do, and it grows harder the longer our war with the Aberrant goes on. We build our defenses up and they knock them down, we send armadas to retake Aviskir and they are routed or never return. It seems that all of our energies must go into this war, and little of our wealth is spent elsewhere. It is little wonder that some say we should seek to truly build a new life here, rather than waste our lives and efforts on reclaiming the old."|130|0
units.english: "Agreement. Yes, we do, and it grows harder the longer our war with the Aberrant goes on. We build our defenses up and they knock them down, we send armadas to retake Aviskir and they are routed or never return. It seems that all of our energies must go into this war, and little of our wealth is spent elsewhere. It is little wonder that some say we should seek to truly build a new life here, rather than waste our lives and efforts on reclaiming the old."
units.italian: "Accordo. Sì, è così, e diventa più dura più la nostra guerra contro l'Aberrante va avanti. Innalziamo le nostre difese e loro le abbattono, mandiamo armate a riprendere Aviskir e vengono messe in rotta o non tornano mai. Pare che tutte le nostre energie debbano andare in questa guerra, e poca della nostra ricchezza è spesa altrove. C'è poco da stupirsi che alcuni dicano che dovremmo cercare di costruire davvero una vita nuova qui, invece di sprecare vite e sforzi per riconquistare il vecchio."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Amusement. Fair to say, as I suppose the perspective of an outsider must be more confused than enlightened, when confronted with a new species, a new civilization, for the first time. And I suppose you have seen little of our true civilization, the planets we left to the Aberrant."|134|0
units.english: "Amusement. Fair to say, as I suppose the perspective of an outsider must be more confused than enlightened, when confronted with a new species, a new civilization, for the first time. And I suppose you have seen little of our true civilization, the planets we left to the Aberrant."
units.italian: "Divertimento. È giusto dirlo, suppongo, perché la prospettiva di un estraneo deve essere più confusa che illuminata, davanti a una nuova specie, una nuova civiltà, per la prima volta. E suppongo che tu abbia visto poco della nostra vera civiltà, i pianeti che abbiamo lasciato all'Aberrante."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Regardless, I wonder what you would think of us, had you arrived before the Aberrant threw us from our homes. Conflict. It is almost a shame to me that you have to see us in our current state, but then I think of the unity and selflessness that we have found in each other, and that fills me with pride."|137|0
units.english: "Regardless, I wonder what you would think of us, had you arrived before the Aberrant threw us from our homes. Conflict. It is almost a shame to me that you have to see us in our current state, but then I think of the unity and selflessness that we have found in each other, and that fills me with pride."
units.italian: "Ciò nonostante, mi chiedo che cosa penseresti di noi se fossi arrivato prima che l'Aberrante ci scacciasse dalle nostre case. Conflitto. È quasi un peccato, per me, che tu debba vederci nello stato attuale, ma poi penso all'unità e all'abnegazione che abbiamo trovato gli uni negli altri, e questo mi riempie di orgoglio."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	You play a few more rounds back and forth, each of you advancing towards your respective exits. It is once more your turn.|138|0
units.english: You play a few more rounds back and forth, each of you advancing towards your respective exits. It is once more your turn.
units.italian: Giocate ancora qualche giro, ognuno di voi avanzando verso la propria uscita. È di nuovo il tuo turno.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Move a stone towards my escape.)|140|0
units.english: (Move a stone towards my escape.)
units.italian: (Muovi una pietra verso la mia fuga.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Move a new stone towards my escape.)|144|0
units.english: (Move a new stone towards my escape.)
units.italian: (Muovi una nuova pietra verso la mia fuga.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Move my stone further towards my escape.)|148|0
units.english: (Move my stone further towards my escape.)
units.italian: (Muovi la mia pietra più avanti verso la mia fuga.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Prepare to block Wisteria. Move a stone towards his triangle.)|152|0
units.english: (Prepare to block Wisteria. Move a stone towards his triangle.)
units.italian: (Preparati a bloccare Wisteria. Muovi una pietra verso il suo triangolo.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Further block Wisteria. Move a new stone towards his side)|156|0
units.english: (Further block Wisteria. Move a new stone towards his side)
units.italian: (Blocca ancora Wisteria. Muovi una nuova pietra verso il suo lato.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Move my blocking stone further towards Wisteria's side)|160|0
units.english: (Move my blocking stone further towards Wisteria's side)
units.italian: (Muovi più avanti la mia pietra di blocco verso il lato di Wisteria.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	(Move a stone towards the Foil triangle. Why not?)|164|0
units.english: (Move a stone towards the Foil triangle. Why not?)
units.italian: (Muovi una pietra verso il triangolo del Foil. Perché no?)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. Balancing your movements between hindering me and evacuating your own pieces is the key to victory, and keeping multiple pieces in play is critical to achieving that balance."|170|0
units.english: "Approving. Balancing your movements between hindering me and evacuating your own pieces is the key to victory, and keeping multiple pieces in play is critical to achieving that balance."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Bilanciare le tue mosse tra l'intralciarmi e l'evacuare i tuoi pezzi è la chiave della vittoria, e tenere più pezzi in gioco è essenziale per raggiungere quell'equilibrio."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Consideration. You are focused on escape, with no inclination towards hindering me. A good strategy for the first few moves, but winning almost always requires some form of interference with the other side, even if it means entangling your pieces in defensive formations."|176|0
units.english: "Consideration. You are focused on escape, with no inclination towards hindering me. A good strategy for the first few moves, but winning almost always requires some form of interference with the other side, even if it means entangling your pieces in defensive formations."
units.italian: "Considerazione. Sei concentrato sulla fuga, senza alcuna inclinazione a intralciarmi. Una buona strategia per le prime mosse, ma vincere richiede quasi sempre una qualche forma di interferenza con l'altra parte, anche a costo di impigliare i tuoi pezzi in formazioni difensive."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Consideration. You are focused on fleeing with that single piece, without having moved your other pieces. A good strategy for the first few moves if your goal is to set up a formation for use later, but you must be careful to avoid leaving the rest of your pieces behind."|182|0
units.english: "Consideration. You are focused on fleeing with that single piece, without having moved your other pieces. A good strategy for the first few moves if your goal is to set up a formation for use later, but you must be careful to avoid leaving the rest of your pieces behind."
units.italian: "Considerazione. Sei concentrato sul fuggire con quel singolo pezzo, senza aver mosso gli altri. Una buona strategia per le prime mosse se il tuo scopo è preparare una formazione da usare più tardi, ma devi fare attenzione a non lasciarti indietro il resto dei pezzi."

units.italian: block wisteria 3a

units.english: "Approving. Balancing your movements between hindering me and evacuating your own pieces is the key to victory, and keeping multiple pieces in play is critical to achieving that balance, especially as you may use your pieces to skip towards me."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Bilanciare le tue mosse tra l'intralciarmi e l'evacuare i tuoi pezzi è la chiave della vittoria, e tenere più pezzi in gioco è essenziale per raggiungere quell'equilibrio, soprattutto perché puoi usare i tuoi pezzi per saltare verso di me."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|label|191|0

units.italian: block wisteria 3b

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. Your efforts thus far are focused on reacting to me, but you are making good use of multiple pieces that may later be arranged into a wall."|194|0
units.english: "Approving. Your efforts thus far are focused on reacting to me, but you are making good use of multiple pieces that may later be arranged into a wall."
units.italian: "Approvazione. I tuoi sforzi finora sono concentrati sul reagire a me, ma stai facendo buon uso di più pezzi che potranno poi essere disposti a muro."

units.italian: block wisteria 3c

Your efforts thus far are focused on reacting to me, but you should keep in mind that a single stone will not do much to block me, and may in fact be exploited to form a chain for my own use, should you not use your own pieces to constrain its endpoint."|200|0
units.english: "Consideration. Your efforts thus far are focused on reacting to me, but you should keep in mind that a single stone will not do much to block me, and may in fact be exploited to form a chain for my own use, should you not use your own pieces to constrain its endpoint."
units.italian: "Considerazione. I tuoi sforzi finora sono concentrati sul reagire a me, ma dovresti tenere presente che una singola pietra non farà molto per bloccarmi, e potrebbe anzi essere sfruttata per formare una catena a mio uso, se non usi i tuoi pezzi per vincolarne l'estremità."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|label|203|0
units.english: block foil 3
units.italian: block foil 3

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Bemusement. I am not sure if you are tricking me with some plan, but that is certainly an unusual move."|206|0
units.english: "Bemusement. I am not sure if you are tricking me with some plan, but that is certainly an unusual move."
units.italian: "Sconcerto. Non sono sicuro che tu mi stia ingannando con qualche piano, ma è certo una mossa insolita."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	Wisteria quickly completes his own move, as well as his movement of the Foil. Now he seems to be moving a piece in your direction, perhaps to block you. After a few more back-and-forth moves between the two of you, he asks you another question.|210|0
units.english: Wisteria quickly completes his own move, as well as his movement of the Foil. Now he seems to be moving a piece in your direction, perhaps to block you. After a few more back-and-forth moves between the two of you, he asks you another question.
units.italian: Wisteria completa in fretta la propria mossa, e anche il suo movimento del Foil. Ora sembra spostare un pezzo in direzione tua, forse per bloccarti. Dopo qualche altro scambio di mosse tra voi due, ti pone un'altra domanda.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"So, Captain <last>. I am curious. If you found yourself in our place, an invincible enemy placed between yourself, armed with the last dregs of your people's spacefaring strength, and the bulk of your people held hostage on their very planets but otherwise unharmed, what would you do, question? Would you abandon them to their fate to build a new life out amongst the stars, or gamble your remaining strength on a bet to liberate them?"|211|0
units.english: "So, Captain <last>. I am curious. If you found yourself in our place, an invincible enemy placed between yourself, armed with the last dregs of your people's spacefaring strength, and the bulk of your people held hostage on their very planets but otherwise unharmed, what would you do, question? Would you abandon them to their fate to build a new life out amongst the stars, or gamble your remaining strength on a bet to liberate them?"
units.italian: "Dunque, capitano <last>. Sono curioso. Se ti trovassi al nostro posto, con un nemico invincibile frapposto tra te e gli ultimi rimasugli della forza spaziale del tuo popolo, e la maggior parte della tua gente tenuta in ostaggio sui suoi stessi pianeti ma per il resto incolume, che cosa faresti, domanda? Li abbandoneresti al loro destino per costruire una vita nuova tra le stelle, o giocheresti le tue forze residue su una scommessa per liberarli?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"You can't just abandon everyone on your planets. Surely there's a way to win against the Aberrant, even if it takes sacrifice."|213|0
units.english: "You can't just abandon everyone on your planets. Surely there's a way to win against the Aberrant, even if it takes sacrifice."
units.italian: "Non puoi semplicemente abbandonare tutti sui vostri pianeti. Ci sarà certo un modo per vincere contro l'Aberrante, anche a costo di sacrifici."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"If the Aberrant aren't attacking the surfaces of the Avgi worlds, maybe you should focus on making life better out here first. After all, you have people out here to take care of too."|215|0
units.english: "If the Aberrant aren't attacking the surfaces of the Avgi worlds, maybe you should focus on making life better out here first. After all, you have people out here to take care of too."
units.italian: "Se l'Aberrante non attacca le superfici dei mondi Avgi, forse dovreste prima concentrarvi sul rendere migliore la vita quaggiù. Dopo tutto, avete anche gente qui di cui prendervi cura."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"I would find another way. Communicating with the Aberrant maybe, or finding a way to both fight the war and help the people out here."|217|0
units.english: "I would find another way. Communicating with the Aberrant maybe, or finding a way to both fight the war and help the people out here."
units.italian: "Cercherei un'altra via. Comunicare con l'Aberrante, forse, o trovare il modo di combattere la guerra e aiutare insieme la gente quaggiù."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Appreciation. Such is the opinion of most of us, those who feel lucky to have escaped in the first place and feel a certain obligation to help the rest of our people. But the way forward is unclear. If we build our strength, our military might, perhaps we will have a chance in the future to truly drive the Aberrant from our homes, but just how far we can drive the free Avgi of the Consonance, I do not know. Perhaps it will break us, and leave us with no victory at all."|221|0
units.english: "Appreciation. Such is the opinion of most of us, those who feel lucky to have escaped in the first place and feel a certain obligation to help the rest of our people. But the way forward is unclear. If we build our strength, our military might, perhaps we will have a chance in the future to truly drive the Aberrant from our homes, but just how far we can drive the free Avgi of the Consonance, I do not know. Perhaps it will break us, and leave us with no victory at all."
units.italian: "Riconoscenza. È l'opinione di quasi tutti noi, di quelli che si sentono fortunati a essere fuggiti e provano un certo obbligo di aiutare il resto del nostro popolo. Ma la via avanti non è chiara. Se costruiamo la nostra forza, la nostra potenza militare, forse avremo in futuro la possibilità di scacciare davvero l'Aberrante dalle nostre case, ma fino a che punto possiamo spingere gli Avgi liberi della Consonanza, non lo so. Forse ci spezzerà, e non ci lascerà alcuna vittoria."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Contemplation. That view would have been anathema to us only a short few years ago, but it is one that is steadily gaining ground. With each defeat and failed expedition back to the Twilight, the calls grow to focus on preserving what we have, not reaching to reclaim the old. And many say that those on the old worlds are safe, for now, and may even be able to build a fleet to liberate themselves, if they can but reclaim their orbital shipyards and asteroid mines. If that truly is the case, they say, then we should build ourselves up as a bastion first, with the living space and abundance to support our population."|225|0
units.english: "Contemplation. That view would have been anathema to us only a short few years ago, but it is one that is steadily gaining ground. With each defeat and failed expedition back to the Twilight, the calls grow to focus on preserving what we have, not reaching to reclaim the old. And many say that those on the old worlds are safe, for now, and may even be able to build a fleet to liberate themselves, if they can but reclaim their orbital shipyards and asteroid mines. If that truly is the case, they say, then we should build ourselves up as a bastion first, with the living space and abundance to support our population."
units.italian: "Contemplazione. Quella visione sarebbe stata anatema per noi solo pochi anni fa, ma sta guadagnando terreno costantemente. A ogni sconfitta e a ogni spedizione fallita verso il Twilight, crescono le voci che dicono di concentrarsi sul conservare ciò che abbiamo, non sul tendere a riconquistare il vecchio. E molti dicono che quelli sui vecchi mondi sono al sicuro, per ora, e che potrebbero persino costruire una flotta per liberarsi da soli, se solo riuscissero a riprendersi i cantieri orbitali e le miniere di asteroidi. Se davvero è così, dicono, allora dovremmo prima costruire noi stessi come bastione, con lo spazio vitale e l'abbondanza per sostenere la nostra popolazione."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|label|228|0
units.english: another way
units.italian: another way

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Amusement. Always in search of another way, everyone is. Perhaps because the choice we are left with is so abhorrent, that seeking another way provides a means of relieving them of it. We have attempted communication with the Aberrant, to no avail, and it seems likely they are not an intelligent species to begin with. They do not appear to coordinate with each other, and examining their debris in the rare instances we have managed to destroy one reveals no crew, just a strange mixture of machine and flesh. Perhaps they are some forgotten living weapon, engineered by a race long gone, or the mere servants of some ancient race far beyond us in power, the equivalents of our mining drones and service robots."|229|0
units.english: "Amusement. Always in search of another way, everyone is. Perhaps because the choice we are left with is so abhorrent, that seeking another way provides a means of relieving them of it. We have attempted communication with the Aberrant, to no avail, and it seems likely they are not an intelligent species to begin with. They do not appear to coordinate with each other, and examining their debris in the rare instances we have managed to destroy one reveals no crew, just a strange mixture of machine and flesh. Perhaps they are some forgotten living weapon, engineered by a race long gone, or the mere servants of some ancient race far beyond us in power, the equivalents of our mining drones and service robots."
units.italian: "Divertimento. Sempre in cerca di un'altra via, tutti quanti. Forse perché la scelta che ci resta è tanto ripugnante che cercare un'altra via offre il modo di esserne sollevati. Abbiamo tentato di comunicare con l'Aberrante, senza esito, e sembra probabile che non sia affatto una specie intelligente. Non sembra che si coordinino tra loro, e esaminare i loro rottami nelle rare occasioni in cui siamo riusciti a distruggerne uno non rivela alcun equipaggio, solo uno strano miscuglio di macchina e carne. Forse sono un'arma vivente dimenticata, progettata da una razza scomparsa da tempo, o semplici servi di qualche antica razza molto superiore a noi in potenza, l'equivalente dei nostri droni minerari e dei nostri robot di servizio."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	He splays his arms. "But no, a choice must be made in the end, even if it is only one of degree. Even should we attempt to both build new homes in the Outer Limits and protract our conflict with the Aberrant, the resources allocated to each still remain to be divided up. And there, the conflict between the Consonance and Dissonance lies."|230|0
units.english: He splays his arms. "But no, a choice must be made in the end, even if it is only one of degree. Even should we attempt to both build new homes in the Outer Limits and protract our conflict with the Aberrant, the resources allocated to each still remain to be divided up. And there, the conflict between the Consonance and Dissonance lies."
units.italian: Apre i bracci. "Ma no, alla fine una scelta va fatta, anche se solo di grado. Anche se tentassimo di costruire nuove case negli Outer Limits e di protrarre insieme il nostro conflitto con l'Aberrante, le risorse assegnate a ciascuno resterebbero comunque da dividere. E lì sta il conflitto tra la Consonanza e la Dissonanza."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	You play a few more rounds with Wisteria, and he shows you how to set up chains of pieces that can be used to skip ahead, while also denying their use to the enemy. After a particularly interesting set of moves, where he demonstrates how to break a chain and add your own endpoints to it, the conversation once more turns to politics.|233|0
units.english: You play a few more rounds with Wisteria, and he shows you how to set up chains of pieces that can be used to skip ahead, while also denying their use to the enemy. After a particularly interesting set of moves, where he demonstrates how to break a chain and add your own endpoints to it, the conversation once more turns to politics.
units.italian: Giocate ancora qualche giro con Wisteria, e lui ti mostra come disporre catene di pezzi da usare per saltare avanti, negandone al tempo stesso l'uso al nemico. Dopo una serie di mosse particolarmente interessante, in cui ti dimostra come spezzare una catena e aggiungervi le tue estremità, la conversazione torna di nuovo alla politica.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Curiosity. I am reminded, Captain <last>, that you likely do not know much of our system of government in the first place. Am I right in this, question?"|234|0
units.english: "Curiosity. I am reminded, Captain <last>, that you likely do not know much of our system of government in the first place. Am I right in this, question?"
units.italian: "Curiosità. Mi sovviene, capitano <last>, che probabilmente non sai molto del nostro sistema di governo, tanto per cominciare. Ho ragione, domanda?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"I think I know a little."|236|0
units.english: "I think I know a little."
units.italian: "Credo di saperne un po'."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Yeah, I don't know much aside from there being an Assembly that you vote in."|237|0
units.english: "Yeah, I don't know much aside from there being an Assembly that you vote in."
units.italian: "Sì, non so molto, a parte che c'è un'Assemblea in cui votate."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Consideration. I see. It is something that should be rectified, then, to make your time among us less confusing. The first thing that you should know is that the Avgi are not, nor have ever been, united under a single government."|240|0
units.english: "Consideration. I see. It is something that should be rectified, then, to make your time among us less confusing. The first thing that you should know is that the Avgi are not, nor have ever been, united under a single government."
units.italian: "Considerazione. Capisco. Allora è cosa da rimediare, per rendere meno confuso il tuo tempo tra noi. La prima cosa che devi sapere è che gli Avgi non sono, né sono mai stati, uniti sotto un solo governo."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|244|0
units.english: There are thousands of Avgi governments called polities, which seem to resemble city-states or ideological identities more than true nations. Many, if not most, have banded together into the Consonance, where Electors with varying political weight based on the population of their respective polities make consensus decisions for the species as a whole.
units.italian: Ci sono migliaia di governi Avgi chiamati entità politiche, che sembrano somigliare più a città-stato o a identità ideologiche che a vere nazioni. Molti, se non la maggior parte, si sono riuniti nella Consonanza, dove gli Elettori, con peso politico variabile in base alla popolazione delle rispettive entità, prendono decisioni per consenso a nome dell'intera specie.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Explanation. The Assembly of Polities, as it is formally named, is a rather complicated institution. As its name suggests, it is, well, an assembly of polities. Polities being... associations, or identities. I have read of your human histories, and you could perhaps consider them an analog of nations, but with two key differences."|246|0
units.english: "Explanation. The Assembly of Polities, as it is formally named, is a rather complicated institution. As its name suggests, it is, well, an assembly of polities. Polities being... associations, or identities. I have read of your human histories, and you could perhaps consider them an analog of nations, but with two key differences."
units.italian: "Spiegazione. L'Assemblea delle Entità, come si chiama formalmente, è un'istituzione piuttosto complicata. Come dice il nome, è, beh, un'assemblea di entità. Le entità essendo... associazioni, o identità. Ho letto delle vostre storie umane, e potresti forse considerarle analoghe alle nazioni, ma con due differenze chiave."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	Wisteria raises a sharp finger. "One, they are not geographically bounded. Oh, many will perhaps have ownership over various pieces of land and space stations, but that is in constant flux, and they are rarely joined into a contiguous whole. And two, an individual Avgi can belong to any number of polities at the same time. Citizenship, you may think of it, is shared - and diluted - between as many polities as an Avgi wishes to belong to. Religion, ethnic heritage, economic sector, and even common interests are the most common lines by which polities might base themselves around, but there is one for almost any group imaginable. Even major corporations, or industries that have banded together."|247|0
units.english: Wisteria raises a sharp finger. "One, they are not geographically bounded. Oh, many will perhaps have ownership over various pieces of land and space stations, but that is in constant flux, and they are rarely joined into a contiguous whole. And two, an individual Avgi can belong to any number of polities at the same time. Citizenship, you may think of it, is shared - and diluted - between as many polities as an Avgi wishes to belong to. Religion, ethnic heritage, economic sector, and even common interests are the most common lines by which polities might base themselves around, but there is one for almost any group imaginable. Even major corporations, or industries that have banded together."
units.italian: Wisteria alza un dito affilato. "Primo, non sono delimitate geograficamente. Oh, molte avranno forse proprietà di vari pezzi di terra e stazioni spaziali, ma questo è in continuo mutamento, e raramente sono unite in un tutto contiguo. E secondo, un singolo Avgi può appartenere a un numero qualsiasi di entità allo stesso tempo. La cittadinanza, potresti pensare, è condivisa, e diluita, tra tutte le entità a cui un Avgi desidera appartenere. Religione, eredità etnica, settore economico e persino interessi comuni sono le linee più comuni su cui le entità possono fondarsi, ma ce n'è una per quasi ogni gruppo immaginabile. Persino le grandi corporazioni, o industrie che si sono riunite."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	He spreads his arms out as if presenting a great circle. "The Assembly was an attempt at securing harmony between these polities, to prevent conflicts, and when that became impossible, to set the rules and limits of war. One representative, an Elector, per polity, with a vote weighted by the number of Avgi belonging to it, and by how those Avgi had chosen to dilute their own membership among the various polities. And from them they select three Speakers, a Triumvirate to lead the leaders."|248|0
units.english: He spreads his arms out as if presenting a great circle. "The Assembly was an attempt at securing harmony between these polities, to prevent conflicts, and when that became impossible, to set the rules and limits of war. One representative, an Elector, per polity, with a vote weighted by the number of Avgi belonging to it, and by how those Avgi had chosen to dilute their own membership among the various polities. And from them they select three Speakers, a Triumvirate to lead the leaders."
units.italian: Allarga i bracci come a presentare un grande cerchio. "L'Assemblea era un tentativo di assicurare l'armonia tra queste entità, di prevenire i conflitti e, quando ciò divenne impossibile, di stabilire le regole e i limiti della guerra. Un rappresentante, un Elettore, per entità, con un voto pesato dal numero di Avgi che ne fanno parte e da come quegli Avgi hanno scelto di diluire la propria appartenenza tra le varie entità. E tra loro scelgono tre Portavoce, un Triumvirato che guida i leader."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Do the Avgi in a polity elect their Elector?"|250|0
units.english: "Do the Avgi in a polity elect their Elector?"
units.italian: "Gli Avgi di un'entità eleggono il proprio Elettore?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Corporations are part of the government? I've seen that one before."|251|0
units.english: "Corporations are part of the government? I've seen that one before."
units.italian: "Le corporazioni fanno parte del governo? Questa l'ho già vista."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|254|0
units.english: While most of the Electors the various Avgi polities select to represent them in the Consonance are elected democratically, others are not, with their own systems of appointment. The Consonance is thus perhaps an example of a republic that is not fully democratic.
units.italian: Mentre la maggior parte degli Elettori che le varie entità Avgi scelgono per rappresentarle nella Consonanza sono eletti democraticamente, altri non lo sono, con sistemi propri di nomina. La Consonanza è dunque forse un esempio di repubblica non pienamente democratica.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	He shrugs, an oddly human gesture. "It depends. Many polities do not even elect their own leadership, and they are free to select their representative however they wish. For some it is an elected position, for others it is one appointed by their leadership. A few even have their head of government serve as their Elector, though that is quite the time commitment to make."|256|0
units.english: He shrugs, an oddly human gesture. "It depends. Many polities do not even elect their own leadership, and they are free to select their representative however they wish. For some it is an elected position, for others it is one appointed by their leadership. A few even have their head of government serve as their Elector, though that is quite the time commitment to make."
units.italian: Fa un'alzata di spalle, un gesto stranamente umano. "Dipende. Molte entità non eleggono nemmeno i propri capi, e sono libere di scegliere il proprio rappresentante come vogliono. Per alcune è una carica elettiva, per altre è nominata dai loro vertici. Alcune fanno persino svolgere al proprio capo di governo il ruolo di Elettore, anche se è un impegno di tempo notevole."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	Wisteria looks up. "But yes, most of the polities use some form of democracy. An Avgi might find themselves voting in several elections, one for each polity they claim membership to, with their vote diluted by how many polities they belong to."|257|0
units.english: Wisteria looks up. "But yes, most of the polities use some form of democracy. An Avgi might find themselves voting in several elections, one for each polity they claim membership to, with their vote diluted by how many polities they belong to."
units.italian: Wisteria alza lo sguardo. "Ma sì, la maggior parte delle entità usa una qualche forma di democrazia. Un Avgi può trovarsi a votare in diverse elezioni, una per ogni entità di cui rivendica l'appartenenza, con il proprio voto diluito da quante entità sono."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	Wisteria thrums in laughter. "Amusement. Yes, I've heard of your Syndicate. It was strange to me, to hear of a corporation that wished for the burden of true governance, instead of leaving that to your Republic. It seems to me that the industrial polities here try their best to avoid any responsibility, while still reaping the benefits of representation."|261|0
units.english: Wisteria thrums in laughter. "Amusement. Yes, I've heard of your Syndicate. It was strange to me, to hear of a corporation that wished for the burden of true governance, instead of leaving that to your Republic. It seems to me that the industrial polities here try their best to avoid any responsibility, while still reaping the benefits of representation."
units.italian: Wisteria vibra di risate. "Divertimento. Sì, ho sentito del vostro Sindacato. Mi è sembrato strano sentire di una corporazione che desiderava il fardello del vero governo, invece di lasciarlo alla vostra Repubblica. Mi pare che le entità industriali qui facciano del loro meglio per evitare ogni responsabilità, continuando però a raccogliere i benefici della rappresentanza."

units.english: "Amusement. And of course there are internal factions within the Assembly, as likeminded polities work together to advance their agendas, then just as quickly abandon each other. A harsh world, the Assembly is."
units.italian: "Divertimento. E naturalmente ci sono fazioni interne all'Assemblea, mentre entità affini lavorano insieme per portare avanti i propri programmi, per poi abbandonarsi l'un l'altra altrettanto in fretta. Un mondo duro, l'Assemblea."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"What factions are there in the Assembly?"|267|0
units.english: "What factions are there in the Assembly?"
units.italian: "Quali fazioni ci sono nell'Assemblea?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"They're all that ruthless, even now?"|269|0
units.english: "They're all that ruthless, even now?"
units.italian: "Sono tutti così spietati, anche ora?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	Wisteria laughs. "Of course they are. Oh, most of them have the same goal in the end, defeating the Aberrant, but there are many who are convinced that their methods are best suited for achieving that goal."|270|0
units.english: Wisteria laughs. "Of course they are. Oh, most of them have the same goal in the end, defeating the Aberrant, but there are many who are convinced that their methods are best suited for achieving that goal."
units.italian: Wisteria ride. "Certo che lo sono. Oh, la maggior parte ha alla fine lo stesso obiettivo, sconfiggere l'Aberrante, ma molti sono convinti che i propri metodi siano i più adatti a raggiungerlo."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|274|0
units.english: There are many factions in the Consonance Assembly that compete for power and influence.
units.italian: Ci sono molte fazioni nell'Assemblea della Consonanza che competono per potere e influenza.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|275|0
units.english: The Centralists wish to see the Consonance evolve into a true central government with real power. Mostly popular among smaller polities that would otherwise lack influence, their critics accuse them of authoritarianism while they argue strong leadership is needed to combat the Aberrant.
units.italian: I Centralisti vogliono vedere la Consonanza evolvere in un vero governo centrale con potere reale. Sono popolari soprattutto tra le entità più piccole, che altrimenti non avrebbero influenza; i loro critici li accusano di autoritarismo, mentre loro sostengono che una guida forte è necessaria per combattere l'Aberrante.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|276|0
units.english: The Technocrats are a group of corporate and industrial polities that believe in the power of technology to defeat the Aberrant. Besides a shared interest in funding research and development projects, they often conflict with each other, and the results of their sponsorships have been mixed.
units.italian: I Tecnocrati sono un gruppo di entità corporative e industriali che credono nel potere della tecnologia per sconfiggere l'Aberrante. Oltre a un interesse condiviso nel finanziare progetti di ricerca e sviluppo, sono spesso in conflitto tra loro, e i risultati dei loro patrocini sono stati alterni.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|277|0
units.english: The Financiers are influenced primarily by old money, those families and polities who control the largest trade unions and banking organizations. Their financial power makes them almost universally unpopular to the people, but they work behind the scenes to promote unity and effective governance by taking advantage of their influence.
units.italian: I Finanzieri sono influenzati soprattutto dal denaro vecchio, quelle famiglie ed entità che controllano i maggiori sindacati commerciali e le organizzazioni bancarie. Il loro potere finanziario li rende quasi universalmente impopolari presso la gente, ma lavorano dietro le quinte per promuovere l'unità e un governo efficace, sfruttando la propria influenza.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|278|0
units.english: The Nationalists are a diverse group that rail against the Consonance's subversion of individual polities. They especially resent the consolidation of individual national navies into the Twilight Guard, but are considered a reliable force against perceived overreach.
units.italian: I Nazionalisti sono un gruppo eterogeneo che si scaglia contro la sottomissione delle singole entità da parte della Consonanza. Detestano soprattutto la fusione delle marine nazionali nella Twilight Guard, ma sono considerati una forza affidabile contro quelle che percepiscono come ingerenze.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|279|0
units.english: The Ecologists are a single issue faction that simply desires the settlement of Weledos. Many have sympathies to the increasingly popular position that the Avgi should focus on settling the Tangled Shroud instead of trying to reclaim Aviskir.
units.italian: Gli Ecologisti sono una fazione a tema unico che desidera semplicemente la colonizzazione di Weledos. Molti simpatizzano con la posizione sempre più popolare secondo cui gli Avgi dovrebbero concentrarsi sul popolare il Tangled Shroud invece di cercare di riconquistare Aviskir.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|280|0
units.english: The Freelancers have little in common besides a disdain for the taxes and financial controls imposed by the Assembly. Many with Dissonance sympathies can be found among them, but just as many are loyal Consonance supporters who merely desire lower taxes.
units.italian: Gli Indipendenti hanno poco in comune oltre al disprezzo per le tasse e i controlli finanziari imposti dall'Assemblea. Molti con simpatie per la Dissonanza si trovano tra loro, ma altrettanti sono leali sostenitori della Consonanza che desiderano soltanto tasse più basse.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	He ticks them off on his pointed fingers, three on each hand. "There are the Centralists, those from the smaller polities who wish to see the Consonance grow in authority and power. The war against the Aberrant demands strong leaders, they say, and many agree with them." He tilts his head to the left.|282|0
units.english: He ticks them off on his pointed fingers, three on each hand. "There are the Centralists, those from the smaller polities who wish to see the Consonance grow in authority and power. The war against the Aberrant demands strong leaders, they say, and many agree with them." He tilts his head to the left.
units.italian: Li elenca sulle dita affilate, tre per mano. "Ci sono i Centralisti, quelli delle entità più piccole che vogliono vedere la Consonanza crescere in autorità e potere. La guerra contro l'Aberrante esige leader forti, dicono, e molti sono d'accordo con loro." Inclina la testa a sinistra.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"The Technocrats, they disdain that, and place their hopes in a qualitative solution to defeat the Aberrant. Build better ships and give them better weapons, and the Aberrant can be swept from the Twilight without the need to demand ever more resources from our people. They draw from many of the industrialist polities, but their loyalties are often divided," he says as he makes a move.|283|0
units.english: "The Technocrats, they disdain that, and place their hopes in a qualitative solution to defeat the Aberrant. Build better ships and give them better weapons, and the Aberrant can be swept from the Twilight without the need to demand ever more resources from our people. They draw from many of the industrialist polities, but their loyalties are often divided," he says as he makes a move.
units.italian: "I Tecnocrati, che disdegnano questo e ripongono le proprie speranze in una soluzione qualitativa per sconfiggere l'Aberrante. Costruire navi migliori e dar loro armi migliori, e l'Aberrante potrà essere spazzato via dal Twilight senza dover chiedere sempre più risorse alla nostra gente. Attingono a molte delle entità industriali, ma le loro lealtà sono spesso divise," dice mentre fa una mossa.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"The Financiers, the old money types with their fingers in everything, they represented many of the more urbanized regions of the core worlds, and their influence has come with them. Disdained by everyone in public, and beloved by all who would seek to benefit from their influence, I would credit them for being half the reason for the present unity between polities that would normally refuse to cooperate with each other," he says with an amused flick of his wings.|284|0
units.english: "The Financiers, the old money types with their fingers in everything, they represented many of the more urbanized regions of the core worlds, and their influence has come with them. Disdained by everyone in public, and beloved by all who would seek to benefit from their influence, I would credit them for being half the reason for the present unity between polities that would normally refuse to cooperate with each other," he says with an amused flick of his wings.
units.italian: "I Finanzieri, quelli del denaro vecchio con le dita in ogni cosa, rappresentano molte delle regioni più urbanizzate dei mondi centrali, e la loro influenza è venuta con loro. Disprezzati da tutti in pubblico, e amati da chiunque cerchi di trarre vantaggio dalla loro influenza, direi che sono metà della ragione dell'attuale unità tra entità che di norma rifiuterebbero di cooperare," dice con un colpo d'ala divertito.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"There are more, of course, with lesser influence. The Nationalists, who resent the decline of their polities' power, and especially the subsumption of their militaries into the Twilight Guard, are an ever-present thorn in the side of the Centralists, but they at least are quick to point out authoritarianism when they see it. The Ecologists want but a single thing, the complete settlement of Weledos, and the refocusing of resources on colonization and construction rather than shipbuilding. And there is a loose coalition, the Freelancers, who agree on nothing except that taxes and price controls should be relaxed."|285|0
units.english: "There are more, of course, with lesser influence. The Nationalists, who resent the decline of their polities' power, and especially the subsumption of their militaries into the Twilight Guard, are an ever-present thorn in the side of the Centralists, but they at least are quick to point out authoritarianism when they see it. The Ecologists want but a single thing, the complete settlement of Weledos, and the refocusing of resources on colonization and construction rather than shipbuilding. And there is a loose coalition, the Freelancers, who agree on nothing except that taxes and price controls should be relaxed."
units.italian: "Ce ne sono altri, naturalmente, con minore influenza. I Nazionalisti, che mal sopportano il declino del potere delle loro entità e soprattutto l'assorbimento delle loro forze armate nella Twilight Guard, sono una spina costante nel fianco dei Centralisti, ma almeno sono pronti a segnalare l'autoritarismo quando lo vedono. Gli Ecologisti vogliono una sola cosa, la completa colonizzazione di Weledos, e il riorientamento delle risorse verso la colonizzazione e le costruzioni invece che verso la cantieristica. E c'è una coalizione fluida, gli Indipendenti, che non concordano su nulla tranne sul fatto che tasse e controlli dei prezzi dovrebbero essere allentati."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	He sits back. "And of course the Twilight Guard is its own faction, as much as they will emphasize their neutrality. They have their supporters and detractors, but none can oppose them entirely, for they are all that stands between us and the Aberrant."|286|0
units.english: He sits back. "And of course the Twilight Guard is its own faction, as much as they will emphasize their neutrality. They have their supporters and detractors, but none can oppose them entirely, for they are all that stands between us and the Aberrant."
units.italian: Si appoggia allo schienale. "E naturalmente la Twilight Guard è una fazione a sé, per quanto sottolineino la propria neutralità. Hanno sostenitori e detrattori, ma nessuno può opporsi del tutto a loro, perché sono tutto ciò che sta tra noi e l'Aberrante."

units.italian: Detto questo, muove abilmente un pezzo del Foil, intrappolando un gruppo dei tuoi sassi dietro un muro.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. Excellent, you have broken my blockade and turned it to your advantage instead. A good skill for an experienced player to have."|307|0
units.english: "Approving. Excellent, you have broken my blockade and turned it to your advantage instead. A good skill for an experienced player to have."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Eccellente, hai spezzato il mio blocco e l'hai volto a tuo vantaggio. Una buona capacità per un giocatore esperto."

units.english: "Instructing. Ah, you see how you were unable to break the blockade, question? Your formation was not organized well enough for it with the stones you have available, and you would have been better served by ignoring those pieces and making moves elsewhere."
units.italian: "Istruzione. Ah, vedi perché non sei riuscito a spezzare il blocco, domanda? La tua formazione non era organizzata abbastanza bene per farlo con i sassi che hai a disposizione, e ti sarebbe stato più utile ignorare quei pezzi e fare mosse altrove."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Interest. You seem to be abandoning the pieces I have trapped in order to move the rest while I am distracted. A clever strategy, and one that is non-obvious."|319|0
units.english: "Interest. You seem to be abandoning the pieces I have trapped in order to move the rest while I am distracted. A clever strategy, and one that is non-obvious."
units.italian: "Interesse. Sembra che tu stia abbandonando i pezzi che ho intrappolato per muovere gli altri mentre sono distratto. Una strategia intelligente, e non ovvia."
