units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. Instead of trying to break my blockade, which would be difficult, you choose to instead take the opportunity to block in my own pieces, which forces me to respond."|325|0
units.english: "Approving. Instead of trying to break my blockade, which would be difficult, you choose to instead take the opportunity to block in my own pieces, which forces me to respond."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Invece di cercare di spezzare il mio blocco, cosa che sarebbe difficile, scegli di cogliere l'occasione per bloccare i miei pezzi, il che mi costringe a rispondere."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	You play a few more rounds, each of you managing to take a few of your pieces off the board.|328|0
units.english: You play a few more rounds, each of you managing to take a few of your pieces off the board.
units.italian: Giocate ancora qualche giro, e ognuno di voi riesce a togliere dalla tavola qualche pezzo.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"So, what was it like before the Aberrant came?"|330|0
units.english: "So, what was it like before the Aberrant came?"
units.italian: "Allora, com'era prima che arrivasse l'Aberrante?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"What about the Dissonance? I've heard of them."|331|0
units.english: "What about the Dissonance? I've heard of them."
units.italian: "E la Dissonanza? Ne ho sentito parlare."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Contemplation. Perhaps a better question would be, 'what it was like before the hyperdrive?' For our society was not placed into turmoil first by the Aberrant, but rather by the discovery of a means to travel faster than light. Inside a handful of years an outlandish physics experiment went from theory to reality, and stars that had been decades or centuries away instead became reachable in first months, then weeks, then days as the hyperdrive continued to improve."|334|0
units.english: "Contemplation. Perhaps a better question would be, 'what it was like before the hyperdrive?' For our society was not placed into turmoil first by the Aberrant, but rather by the discovery of a means to travel faster than light. Inside a handful of years an outlandish physics experiment went from theory to reality, and stars that had been decades or centuries away instead became reachable in first months, then weeks, then days as the hyperdrive continued to improve."
units.italian: "Contemplazione. Forse una domanda migliore sarebbe: com'era prima dell'hyperdrive? Perché la nostra società non è stata gettata nel caos prima dall'Aberrante, ma dalla scoperta di un mezzo per viaggiare più veloce della luce. Nel giro di pochi anni un bizzarro esperimento di fisica passò dalla teoria alla realtà, e stelle che erano a decenni o secoli di distanza diventarono raggiungibili prima in mesi, poi in settimane, poi in giorni, mentre l'hyperdrive continuava a migliorare."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	He leans in. "You must understand, emphasis, just how economically separated the various pockets of Avgi civilization were. Aviskir of course was dominant within the Anax system, but beyond interplanetary politics practically every system was independent in both a political and economic sense. There was no Consonance to organize the various powers, and everyone largely kept to themselves by sheer virtue of the distance and expense involved in interstellar travel."|335|0
units.english: He leans in. "You must understand, emphasis, just how economically separated the various pockets of Avgi civilization were. Aviskir of course was dominant within the Anax system, but beyond interplanetary politics practically every system was independent in both a political and economic sense. There was no Consonance to organize the various powers, and everyone largely kept to themselves by sheer virtue of the distance and expense involved in interstellar travel."
units.italian: Si china in avanti. "Devi capire, sottolineatura, quanto fossero economicamente separate le varie sacche di civiltà Avgi. Aviskir era naturalmente dominante nel sistema Anax, ma al di là della politica interplanetaria praticamente ogni sistema era indipendente, sia politicamente sia economicamente. Non c'era una Consonanza a organizzare le varie potenze, e ognuno se ne stava per conto proprio in virtù della distanza e del costo dei viaggi interstellari."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	Wisteria spreads his arms as if to encompass the entire station. "Then, almost overnight, the situation went from one of extreme separation to one of interconnection. The fleets of vast starships, powered by stores of antimatter or immense lasers, became obsolete, and it suddenly became possible for even moderately well-off individuals to travel between the stars."|336|0
units.english: Wisteria spreads his arms as if to encompass the entire station. "Then, almost overnight, the situation went from one of extreme separation to one of interconnection. The fleets of vast starships, powered by stores of antimatter or immense lasers, became obsolete, and it suddenly became possible for even moderately well-off individuals to travel between the stars."
units.italian: Wisteria allarga i bracci come ad abbracciare l'intera stazione. "Poi, quasi da un giorno all'altro, la situazione passò da una separazione estrema a un'interconnessione. Le flotte di enormi navi stellari, spinte da riserve di antimateria o da immensi laser, divennero obsolete, e all'improvviso divenne possibile anche per individui moderatamente benestanti viaggiare tra le stelle."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Were there wars?"|338|0
units.english: "Were there wars?"
units.italian: "Ci sono state guerre?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Did you colonize new planets?"|340|0
units.english: "Did you colonize new planets?"
units.italian: "Avete colonizzato nuovi pianeti?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Remembrance. Oh, but of course. Only three or four systems, depending on how you count it, were truly colonized before the hyperdrive. There were expeditions sent to more, but they all either failed or remained insignificant up until hyperdrive-equipped ships joined them. We colonized an additional trio of systems, and explored dozens more."|342|0
units.english: "Remembrance. Oh, but of course. Only three or four systems, depending on how you count it, were truly colonized before the hyperdrive. There were expeditions sent to more, but they all either failed or remained insignificant up until hyperdrive-equipped ships joined them. We colonized an additional trio of systems, and explored dozens more."
units.italian: "Ricordo. Oh, ma certo. Solo tre o quattro sistemi, a seconda di come li si conta, furono davvero colonizzati prima dell'hyperdrive. Ne furono inviate spedizioni verso altri, ma fallirono tutti o restarono insignificanti finché non si unirono a loro navi dotate di hyperdrive. Abbiamo colonizzato altri tre sistemi, e ne abbiamo esplorati dozzine."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Remembrance. Some, yes, though not as many as you might expect of us. A few powers on Aviskir tried to seize weaker colonies once they gained access to hyperdrives, but they overestimated their ability to wage war between the stars. It was years before the first truly capable interstellar warships were built, and by then the situation had stabilized enough that there were few polities interested in starting a new war."|346|0
units.english: "Remembrance. Some, yes, though not as many as you might expect of us. A few powers on Aviskir tried to seize weaker colonies once they gained access to hyperdrives, but they overestimated their ability to wage war between the stars. It was years before the first truly capable interstellar warships were built, and by then the situation had stabilized enough that there were few polities interested in starting a new war."
units.italian: "Ricordo. Alcune, sì, anche se non quante potresti aspettarti da noi. Alcune potenze di Aviskir tentarono di prendere il controllo di colonie più deboli una volta ottenuto l'accesso agli hyperdrive, ma sopravvalutarono la propria capacità di fare guerra tra le stelle. Passarono anni prima che fossero costruite le prime navi da guerra interstellari davvero capaci, e ormai la situazione si era stabilizzata abbastanza che poche entità fossero interessate a cominciare una nuova guerra."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"But the true consequence was the creation of the Consonance. With Avgi civilization once more connected, there was a vision of a grand forum of each and every polity, a united Avgi civilization, at least in name."|350|0
units.english: "But the true consequence was the creation of the Consonance. With Avgi civilization once more connected, there was a vision of a grand forum of each and every polity, a united Avgi civilization, at least in name."
units.italian: "Ma la vera conseguenza fu la creazione della Consonanza. Con la civiltà Avgi di nuovo connessa, nacque la visione di un grande consesso di ogni singola entità, una civiltà Avgi unita, almeno di nome."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Caution. Ah. Our wayward cousins. As much as some fearmongers would have you believe, the Dissonance is neither a rival government nor a subversive movement. Rather, they are a collection of those dissatisfied with the Consonance and the Assembly. Their reasons and motivations vary, but their most significant common grievance is the control over prices enforced by the Consonance as they appropriate resources for use by the Twilight Guard. That, and the taxes the Assembly attempts to levy without much success, has turned many against the Consonance, and those polities who fly Dissonance colors reject any allegiance to the Consonance."|354|0
units.english: "Caution. Ah. Our wayward cousins. As much as some fearmongers would have you believe, the Dissonance is neither a rival government nor a subversive movement. Rather, they are a collection of those dissatisfied with the Consonance and the Assembly. Their reasons and motivations vary, but their most significant common grievance is the control over prices enforced by the Consonance as they appropriate resources for use by the Twilight Guard. That, and the taxes the Assembly attempts to levy without much success, has turned many against the Consonance, and those polities who fly Dissonance colors reject any allegiance to the Consonance."
units.italian: "Cautela. Ah. I nostri cugini traviati. Per quanto alcuni profeti di sventura vorrebbero farti credere, la Dissonanza non è né un governo rivale né un movimento sovversivo. È invece una raccolta di insoddisfatti della Consonanza e dell'Assemblea. Le loro ragioni e motivazioni variano, ma il loro più significativo motivo comune di lamentela è il controllo dei prezzi imposto dalla Consonanza mentre si appropria di risorse per uso della Twilight Guard. Questo, e le tasse che l'Assemblea tenta di imporre senza molto successo, hanno voltato molti contro la Consonanza, e quelle entità che battono i colori della Dissonanza rifiutano ogni fedeltà alla Consonanza."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"But don't they know the Twilight Guard is needed to fight the Aberrant? Without them, they'd all be killed."|356|0
units.english: "But don't they know the Twilight Guard is needed to fight the Aberrant? Without them, they'd all be killed."
units.italian: "Ma non sanno che la Twilight Guard serve a combattere l'Aberrante? Senza di loro sarebbero tutti morti."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"That seems too simple. That can't be their only reason for leaving the Consonance, not in an existential war."|358|0
units.english: "That seems too simple. That can't be their only reason for leaving the Consonance, not in an existential war."
units.italian: "Sembra troppo semplice. Non può essere la loro unica ragione per lasciare la Consonanza, non in una guerra esistenziale."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. That is an astute observation, and one you are correct in. It is of course more complicated than a simple disdain for taxation and price controls. There is the matter of sovereignty, the continued decline of the power of the polities as the Consonance takes on additional responsibilities. Many of the polities that created the Consonance no longer exist, and even more are nothing more than a collection of refugees, the bulk of which sleep in cryogenic storage, waiting for us to build the habitable space needed to awaken them. Many resent this, remembering the days of freedom and true independence, and the rejection of Consonance authority is one way to revisit those days."|360|0
units.english: "Approving. That is an astute observation, and one you are correct in. It is of course more complicated than a simple disdain for taxation and price controls. There is the matter of sovereignty, the continued decline of the power of the polities as the Consonance takes on additional responsibilities. Many of the polities that created the Consonance no longer exist, and even more are nothing more than a collection of refugees, the bulk of which sleep in cryogenic storage, waiting for us to build the habitable space needed to awaken them. Many resent this, remembering the days of freedom and true independence, and the rejection of Consonance authority is one way to revisit those days."
units.italian: "Approvazione. È un'osservazione acuta, e hai ragione. È naturalmente più complicato di un semplice disprezzo per le tasse e i controlli dei prezzi. C'è la questione della sovranità, il continuo declino del potere delle entità man mano che la Consonanza si assume nuove responsabilità. Molte delle entità che crearono la Consonanza non esistono più, e ancor più non sono nient'altro che una raccolta di profughi, la maggior parte dei quali dorme in stoccaggio criogenico, in attesa che costruiamo lo spazio abitabile necessario a risvegliarli. Molti se ne risentono, ricordando i giorni di libertà e vera indipendenza, e il rifiuto dell'autorità della Consonanza è un modo per rivisitare quei giorni."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	He turns his head to the side. "Sadness. I cannot say I blame them. They are correct in that the Assembly does grow ever more overbearing, and the fear of more polities leaving the Consonance has served as a check on the tendency for the Assembly to grant itself ever more powers."|361|0
units.english: He turns his head to the side. "Sadness. I cannot say I blame them. They are correct in that the Assembly does grow ever more overbearing, and the fear of more polities leaving the Consonance has served as a check on the tendency for the Assembly to grant itself ever more powers."
units.italian: Volta la testa di lato. "Tristezza. Non posso dire di biasimarli. Hanno ragione che l'Assemblea diventa sempre più oppressiva, e il timore che altre entità lascino la Consonanza è servito da freno alla tendenza dell'Assemblea di concedersi sempre più poteri."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Ah, but is that really the case, question? Many of them would argue that we may simply hide within the Tangled Shroud, or instead dedicate our efforts to fortifying a single system at their entrance. Others oppose not the existence of the Twilight Guard, but rather their continued failed forays back into the Twilight, which they see as a waste of both resources and lives."|365|0
units.english: "Ah, but is that really the case, question? Many of them would argue that we may simply hide within the Tangled Shroud, or instead dedicate our efforts to fortifying a single system at their entrance. Others oppose not the existence of the Twilight Guard, but rather their continued failed forays back into the Twilight, which they see as a waste of both resources and lives."
units.italian: "Ah, ma è davvero così, domanda? Molti di loro obietterebbero che possiamo semplicemente nasconderci dentro il Tangled Shroud, o dedicare invece i nostri sforzi a fortificare un solo sistema al loro ingresso. Altri non si oppongono all'esistenza della Twilight Guard, ma alle sue continue sortite fallite nel Twilight, che vedono come uno spreco di risorse e di vite."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"But I see we approach the end of our game. I can spot a path to victory for myself, but can you, question? I assure you that one exists."|368|0
units.english: "But I see we approach the end of our game. I can spot a path to victory for myself, but can you, question? I assure you that one exists."
units.italian: "Ma vedo che ci avviciniamo alla fine della nostra partita. Riesco a scorgere una via per la vittoria per me, ma tu ci riesci, domanda? Ti assicuro che ne esiste una."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|(Focus on getting the rest of my stones out as quickly as possible.)|370|0
units.english: (Focus on getting the rest of my stones out as quickly as possible.)
units.italian: (Concentrati sul far uscire il resto dei miei sassi il più in fretta possibile.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|(Evacuate the stones I have blocking Wisteria.)|372|0
units.english: (Evacuate the stones I have blocking Wisteria.)
units.italian: (Evacua i sassi che bloccano Wisteria.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|(Try to completely block Wisteria in with my remaining stones before extracting them.)|376|0
units.english: (Try to completely block Wisteria in with my remaining stones before extracting them.)
units.italian: (Prova a bloccare del tutto Wisteria con i miei sassi rimanenti prima di estrarli.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|(Try to completely block Wisteria in with the Foil's stones.)|380|0
units.english: (Try to completely block Wisteria in with the Foil's stones.)
units.italian: (Prova a bloccare del tutto Wisteria con i sassi del Foil.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|(Try to undo the blockades Wisteria has created for me with the Foil's stones.)|384|0
units.english: (Try to undo the blockades Wisteria has created for me with the Foil's stones.)
units.italian: (Prova a disfare i blocchi che Wisteria ha creato per me con i sassi del Foil.)

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. An excellent prioritization of your own pieces."|392|0
units.english: "Approving. An excellent prioritization of your own pieces."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Un'ottima priorità data ai tuoi pezzi."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. An excellent blocking action, one that has delayed me."|398|0
units.english: "Approving. An excellent blocking action, one that has delayed me."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Un'ottima azione di blocco, che mi ha rallentato."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. An excellent blocking action, one that has delayed me without costing you anything."|404|0
units.english: "Approving. An excellent blocking action, one that has delayed me without costing you anything."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Un'ottima azione di blocco, che mi ha rallentato senza costarti nulla."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Approving. An excellent blocking action, one that has delayed me."|410|0
units.english: "Approving. An excellent blocking action, one that has delayed me."
units.italian: "Approvazione. Un'ottima azione di blocco, che mi ha rallentato."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	In the end Wisteria is able to pull ahead and get the last of his pieces off the board before you, and you suspect it was only as close as it was due to him humoring you.|418|0
units.english: In the end Wisteria is able to pull ahead and get the last of his pieces off the board before you, and you suspect it was only as close as it was due to him humoring you.
units.italian: Alla fine Wisteria riesce a passare avanti e a togliere dalla tavola i suoi ultimi pezzi prima di te, e sospetti che sia stata così combattuta solo perché lui ti stava assecondando.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	You play with bated breath as your pieces slowly inch off the board, until at last victory is yours, a scant single move before Wisteria would have evacuated his final piece. You suspect that while he has given you a fair game, he has perhaps gone easy on you to give you a chance to win.|422|0
units.english: You play with bated breath as your pieces slowly inch off the board, until at last victory is yours, a scant single move before Wisteria would have evacuated his final piece. You suspect that while he has given you a fair game, he has perhaps gone easy on you to give you a chance to win.
units.italian: Giochi col fiato sospeso mentre i tuoi pezzi escono lentamente dalla tavola, finché alla fine la vittoria è tua, una sola mossa prima che Wisteria evacui il suo ultimo pezzo. Sospetti che, pur avendoti dato una partita leale, ti abbia forse concesso qualche vantaggio per darti la possibilità di vincere.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|426|0
units.english: Played an Avgi board game in the park with an elderly Avgi named Wisteria.
units.italian: Hai giocato a un gioco da tavolo Avgi nel parco con un anziano Avgi di nome Wisteria.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|log|427|0
units.english: Seemingly an old Avgi who plays board games in the park, Wisteria was formerly one of the First Speakers of the Consonance Assembly before retiring. He has a deep understanding of Avgi politics and history, and is curious about how they compare to those of humanity.
units.italian: Apparentemente un vecchio Avgi che gioca a giochi da tavolo nel parco, Wisteria è stato in passato uno dei Primi Portavoce dell'Assemblea della Consonanza, prima di ritirarsi. Ha una profonda comprensione della politica e della storia Avgi, ed è curioso di sapere come si confrontino con quelle dell'umanità.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Satisfaction. A fine game, Captain <first>," he says, congratulating you. "You are a talented player, and I much enjoyed our conversation during the game." You realize that hours have gone by since you started, with the station's lights simulating a ruddy sunset.|429|0
units.english: "Satisfaction. A fine game, Captain <first>," he says, congratulating you. "You are a talented player, and I much enjoyed our conversation during the game." You realize that hours have gone by since you started, with the station's lights simulating a ruddy sunset.
units.italian: "Soddisfazione. Una bella partita, capitano <first>," dice, congratulandosi con te. "Sei un giocatore di talento, e ho molto gradito la nostra conversazione durante il gioco." Ti rendi conto che sono passate ore da quando hai cominciato, con le luci della stazione che simulano un tramonto rossastro.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Appreciation. Allow me to gift you this Trefoil board, so that you might enjoy the game in your own time. I look forward to meeting you in the future, and perhaps we may even have the chance to play again."|430|0
units.english: "Appreciation. Allow me to gift you this Trefoil board, so that you might enjoy the game in your own time. I look forward to meeting you in the future, and perhaps we may even have the chance to play again."
units.italian: "Riconoscenza. Permettimi di regalarti questa tavola di Trefoil, così che tu possa goderti il gioco nel tuo tempo. Non vedo l'ora di incontrarti in futuro, e forse avremo persino la possibilità di giocare di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	He gently hands you the Trefoil board, bows in respect, then climbs off his rail to depart. "Should you ever wish to speak to me again, ask for the office of former Speaker Wisteria and I will be more than pleased to host you."|431|0
units.english: He gently hands you the Trefoil board, bows in respect, then climbs off his rail to depart. "Should you ever wish to speak to me again, ask for the office of former Speaker Wisteria and I will be more than pleased to host you."
units.italian: Ti porge con delicatezza la tavola di Trefoil, si inchina in segno di rispetto, poi scende dalla sua sbarra per andarsene. "Se mai desiderassi parlarmi di nuovo, chiedi dell'ufficio dell'ex Portavoce Wisteria e sarò più che lieto di ospitarti."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Park Politics|	"Thank you," you say, and it is only after he has left that you realize Wisteria must have been not just an Elector, but one of the First Speakers at some point in the past.|432|0
units.english: "Thank you," you say, and it is only after he has left that you realize Wisteria must have been not just an Elector, but one of the First Speakers at some point in the past.
units.italian: "Grazie," dici, ed è solo dopo che se n'è andato che ti rendi conto che Wisteria doveva essere stato non solo un Elettore, ma uno dei Primi Portavoce in qualche momento del passato.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|log|445|0
units.english: Nikkio is a shifty salesman peddling "Zapchannel Ray Energy," a supposed health tonic with a suspicious glow.
units.italian: Nikkio è un venditore losco che smercia "Zapchannel Ray Energy", un presunto tonico per la salute dalla luminescenza sospetta.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|You are on your way back to the <ship> after a stroll through the spaceport when a bright yellow Avgi lands in front of you. "Hey, you! Enthusiasm! I am Nikkio, famed medician and traveling salesman. Do you, alien sojourner, care for your health?"|449|0
units.english: You are on your way back to the <ship> after a stroll through the spaceport when a bright yellow Avgi lands in front of you. "Hey, you! Enthusiasm! I am Nikkio, famed medician and traveling salesman. Do you, alien sojourner, care for your health?"
units.italian: Stai tornando alla <ship> dopo una passeggiata nello spazioporto quando un Avgi giallo brillante atterra davanti a te. "Ehi, tu! Entusiasmo! Sono Nikkio, famoso medico e venditore ambulante. Tu, straniero di passaggio, t'interessa la tua salute?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"I guess so."|451|0
units.english: "I guess so."
units.italian: "Immagino di sì."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Whatever you're selling, I'm not interested."|453|0
units.english: "Whatever you're selling, I'm not interested."
units.italian: "Qualunque cosa tu stia vendendo, non m'interessa."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	You try to step around him and continue on your way, but he mirrors you, dancing backwards to remain in your face. "Sincerity! You are making a terrible mistake! I have something that could help with your energy, yes?"|455|0
units.english: You try to step around him and continue on your way, but he mirrors you, dancing backwards to remain in your face. "Sincerity! You are making a terrible mistake! I have something that could help with your energy, yes?"
units.italian: Cerchi di aggirarlo e continuare per la tua strada, ma lui ti imita, ballando all'indietro per restarti davanti al viso. "Sincerità! Stai facendo un errore terribile! Ho qualcosa che potrebbe aiutare con la tua energia, sì?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Alright, alright. What is it?"|457|0
units.english: "Alright, alright. What is it?"
units.italian: "Va bene, va bene. Che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Not interested. Now move before I call the authorities."|459|0
units.english: "Not interested. Now move before I call the authorities."
units.italian: "Non m'interessa. Ora spostati prima che chiami le autorità."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Excitement! Wonderful! I have just the thing, certified by the Consonance Health Committee itself, surely!" he says animatedly, arms and wings waving as he dances in front of you. "But, reservation. Hmm. Only the most enterprising of captains could benefit from what I am about to bestow upon you. Are you certain you have what it takes to try Zapchannel Ray Energy?"|463|0
units.english: "Excitement! Wonderful! I have just the thing, certified by the Consonance Health Committee itself, surely!" he says animatedly, arms and wings waving as he dances in front of you. "But, reservation. Hmm. Only the most enterprising of captains could benefit from what I am about to bestow upon you. Are you certain you have what it takes to try Zapchannel Ray Energy?"
units.italian: "Entusiasmo! Meraviglioso! Ho proprio la cosa giusta, certificata dalla Commissione per la Salute della Consonanza in persona, di sicuro!" dice animatamente, braccia e ali che si agitano mentre balla davanti a te. "Ma, riserva. Hmm. Solo i capitani più intraprendenti potrebbero trarre beneficio da ciò che sto per donarti. Sei certo di avere quello che serve per provare lo Zapchannel Ray Energy?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Yes, I'm very experienced, seen the galaxy and all. Now show me what you're talking about."|465|0
units.english: "Yes, I'm very experienced, seen the galaxy and all. Now show me what you're talking about."
units.italian: "Sì, sono molto esperto, ho visto la galassia e tutto il resto. Ora mostrami di cosa stai parlando."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Alright, that's it. Get out of here before I call the authorities."|467|0
units.english: "Alright, that's it. Get out of here before I call the authorities."
units.italian: "Basta così. Vattene via prima che chiami le autorità."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Excitement, excellent! I can see you are clearly a very intelligent and discerning captain. Anticipation. This serum was invented by yours truly, capable of resolving all of your worldly woes! Only 3,000 credits!" He proudly holds out a vial of cloudy white liquid, glowing a bright, intense pale blue.|471|0
units.english: "Excitement, excellent! I can see you are clearly a very intelligent and discerning captain. Anticipation. This serum was invented by yours truly, capable of resolving all of your worldly woes! Only 3,000 credits!" He proudly holds out a vial of cloudy white liquid, glowing a bright, intense pale blue.
units.italian: "Entusiasmo, eccellente! Vedo chiaramente che sei un capitano molto intelligente e accorto. Anticipazione. Questo siero è stato inventato dal sottoscritto, capace di risolvere tutti i tuoi guai terreni! Solo 3.000 crediti!" Porge con orgoglio una fiala di liquido bianco torbido, che emette un bagliore azzurro pallido, vivo e intenso.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Uh, what is this?"|473|0
units.english: "Uh, what is this?"
units.italian: "Uh, che cos'è?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Is this radioactive?"|474|0
units.english: "Is this radioactive?"
units.italian: "È radioattivo?"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"I'm not drinking that."|475|0
units.english: "I'm not drinking that."
units.italian: "Non lo berrò."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Dismissal. Nonsense, this formula is perfectly safe! A serum for the health, proven to kill over three thousand forms of cancer, you should know." As if on cue, the glow pulses menacingly.|477|0
units.english: "Dismissal. Nonsense, this formula is perfectly safe! A serum for the health, proven to kill over three thousand forms of cancer, you should know." As if on cue, the glow pulses menacingly.
units.italian: "Sdegno. Sciocchezze, questa formula è perfettamente sicura! Un siero per la salute, dimostrato capace di uccidere oltre tremila forme di cancro, dovresti saperlo." Come su invito, il bagliore pulsa in modo minaccioso.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Yeah, that doesn't look safe. I'm calling the authorities."|479|0
units.english: "Yeah, that doesn't look safe. I'm calling the authorities."
units.italian: "Sì, non sembra sicuro. Chiamo le autorità."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Alright, I'll give it a shot."|481|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll give it a shot."
units.italian: "Va bene, facciamo un tentativo."

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	You take the vial, warm to the touch, and uncork it. Nikkio gives you an expectant look, and gestures at you before you carefully tip the drink back. You feel a little tingly as the drink trickles down your throat, tasting vaguely of lemon and metal. This quickly intensifies into pins and needles in your chest, spreading as your body starts to go numb. As your vision darkens, punctuated by flashes of light in the corners of your eyes, your last thought is that perhaps you shouldn't have drunk a mysterious glowing liquid given to you by a seedy alien you just met in the spaceport.|485|0
units.english: You take the vial, warm to the touch, and uncork it. Nikkio gives you an expectant look, and gestures at you before you carefully tip the drink back. You feel a little tingly as the drink trickles down your throat, tasting vaguely of lemon and metal. This quickly intensifies into pins and needles in your chest, spreading as your body starts to go numb. As your vision darkens, punctuated by flashes of light in the corners of your eyes, your last thought is that perhaps you shouldn't have drunk a mysterious glowing liquid given to you by a seedy alien you just met in the spaceport.
units.italian: Prendi la fiala, calda al tatto, e la stappi. Nikkio ti lancia uno sguardo pieno di attesa e ti fa un gesto, e tu mandi giù la bevanda con cautela. Senti un leggero formicolio mentre il liquido ti scende in gola, con un vago sapore di limone e di metallo. Presto si intensifica in spilli e aghi nel petto, che si diffondono mentre il corpo comincia a intorpidirsi. Mentre la vista si oscura, punteggiata da lampi di luce agli angoli degli occhi, il tuo ultimo pensiero è che forse non avresti dovuto bere un liquido luminoso e misterioso affidatoti da un alieno losco appena conosciuto allo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|log|490|0
units.english: Met a suspicious-looking Avgi salesman named Nikkio. Accepted a free sample of a strange glowing drink and somehow developed minor superpowers from it.
units.italian: Hai incontrato un venditore Avgi dall'aria losca di nome Nikkio. Hai accettato un campione gratuito di una strana bevanda luminosa e in qualche modo hai sviluppato dei piccoli superpoteri.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	You take the vial, warm to the touch, and uncork it before carefully tipping it back. You feel a little tingly as the drink trickles down your throat, tasting vaguely of lemon and metal. This quickly intensifies into pins and needles in your chest, spreading as you start to feel somehow revitalized. After a brief, sharp pain, a suspiciously dragonfly-shaped patch of skin in the center of your chest begins to glow a vibrant blue.|493|0
units.english: You take the vial, warm to the touch, and uncork it before carefully tipping it back. You feel a little tingly as the drink trickles down your throat, tasting vaguely of lemon and metal. This quickly intensifies into pins and needles in your chest, spreading as you start to feel somehow revitalized. After a brief, sharp pain, a suspiciously dragonfly-shaped patch of skin in the center of your chest begins to glow a vibrant blue.
units.italian: Prendi la fiala, calda al tatto, e la stappi prima di mandarla giù con cautela. Senti un leggero formicolio mentre la bevanda ti scende in gola, con un vago sapore di limone e di metallo. Presto si intensifica in spilli e aghi nel petto, che si diffondono mentre cominci a sentirti in qualche modo rivitalizzato. Dopo un breve dolore acuto, una chiazza di pelle dall'aspetto sospettosamente a forma di libellula al centro del petto comincia a brillare di un blu vibrante.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Surprise. You surely are, ah, a worthy captain!" says Nikkio, shock evident on his face. He begins to sidle away, glancing in all directions as though he isn't sure what's going on. "Hurry. I must be on my way, goodbye for now, captain!"|494|0
units.english: "Surprise. You surely are, ah, a worthy captain!" says Nikkio, shock evident on his face. He begins to sidle away, glancing in all directions as though he isn't sure what's going on. "Hurry. I must be on my way, goodbye for now, captain!"
units.italian: "Sorpresa. Sei davvero, ah, un capitano degno!" dice Nikkio, con lo stupore evidente sul viso. Comincia ad allontanarsi di lato, guardando in ogni direzione come se non fosse sicuro di cosa stia succedendo. "Fretta. Devo andare, addio per ora, capitano!"

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|log|498|0
units.english: Met a suspicious-looking Avgi salesman named Nikkio. Refused his offer of a definitely radioactive "energy drink" that would probably have been lethal.
units.italian: Hai incontrato un venditore Avgi dall'aria losca di nome Nikkio. Hai rifiutato la sua offerta di una "bevanda energetica" decisamente radioattiva che probabilmente sarebbe stata letale.

units.id: mission:Avgi Culture: Zapchannel Energy|	"Alarm. There's no need for that, apologies, apologies! Be on your way, Captain!"|499|0
units.english: "Alarm. There's no need for that, apologies, apologies! Be on your way, Captain!"
units.italian: "Allarme. Non c'è bisogno di questo, scuse, scuse! Vai per la tua strada, capitano!"
